strategic_themes.title: Contracts Finder portfolio review (84 notices; 0 contracts at £10M+ ceiling)
strategic_themes.rationale: Contracts Finder data: 84 notices (45 awarded, £13M aggregate ADVERTISED CEILING value, 0% SME). IMPORTANT: advertised contract value is a CEILING set to avoid retender risk under PCR 2015 Reg.72 / Procurement Act 2023 s.31 — actual spend through the awardee is typically 30-70% of ceiling, with some off-contract ledger spend permitted within the 50%/50% modification limits. 0 contracts at £10M+ ceiling totalling £0M (ceiling, NOT spend) — top 3: . Matched against ledger: GB-Lyme: TPPL Newcastle-under-Lyme Borough Council — ceiling £0.0M, actual ledger spend with awardee £0.2M; GB-Lyme: TPPL Newcastle-Under-Lyme Borough Council — ceiling £2.7M, actual ledger spend with awardee £2.8M; GB-Lyme: TPPL Newcastle-Under-Lyme Borough Council — ceiling £0.7M, actual ledger spend with awardee £2.8M. Aggregate identified actual spend £35M. SME-awarded share 0% is below the Procurement Reform 2023 / PPN 03/24 ambition (33% SME share by value). Standard procurement-data savings levers (% of ACTUAL ledger spend, not ceiling): (a) modification-history scrutiny under PCR 2015 Reg.72, (b) Procurement Act 2023 s.31 contract change notice review, (c) re-tender benchmark vs CCS framework rates on next renewal. 2-8% on actual spend through major contracts is a defensible upper bound.
